causal_order: evaluator-only eligibility and bounded future target construction

freeze.alpha_policy: fixed 0.01 selected before official output; no held-out tuning
freeze.bridge: post-hoc read-only D-034 ALT_4/8/16 and NO_FORWARD_PROGRESS_4/8/16 anchors; no trigger labels or ON/OFF outcomes as features
freeze.feature_encoding: flattened visible-before observations and one-hot executed action; six channels and four action codes per completed transition
freeze.learner: ridge linear regression for progress; ridge linear classifier transformed by sigmoid for reacquisition only when training has both classes
freeze.null_policy: termination, truncation, and lifetime-boundary windows remain explicit and are excluded only from the corresponding fit/metric
freeze.prefix_policy: unavailable prefixes are counted and excluded; no synthetic padding
freeze.target_definition: actual continuation after the completed decision: reacquisition within H transitions and beacon-forward change from the post-action observation to the post-H observation

interpretation.headline: Pending execution; descriptive held-out learnability only.

interpretation_categories.bridge_coherence: successful-recruitment anchors descriptively fall in a learned high-risk/low-progress region more often than matched non-anchor states
interpretation_categories.current_state_is_sufficient: H1 matches bounded-history models within ordinary sampling variation
interpretation_categories.history_adds_learnable_information: one or more bounded histories consistently improve held-out prediction over H1 without a single-seed driver
interpretation_categories.history_signal_weak_or_unstable: some folds improve but pooled/generalization evidence is inconsistent
interpretation_categories.no_bridge_coherence: learnability exists but does not align with D-034 recruitment-success states
interpretation_categories.target_unsupported: class balance or causal support is insufficient; report null/untestable
